inputs.command: set -euo pipefail; cd /opt/madworld; printf '%s\n' '=== configured variable presence in .env ==='; for k in MADWORLD_DATABASE_URL POSTGRES_USER POSTGRES_DB POSTGRES_PASSWORD; do if grep -qE "^${k}=" .env; then echo ${k}=set-in-dotenv; else echo ${k}=absent-from-dotenv; fi; done; printf '%s\n' '=== compose interpolation check ==='; if docker compose --env-file .env -f ops/docker-compose.production.yml config >/dev/null 2>/tmp/mw-compose.err; then echo compose-config=success; else echo compose-config=failed; sed -n '1,12p' /tmp/mw-compose.err; fi

remote_result.stdout:
=== configured variable presence in .env ===
MADWORLD_DATABASE_URL=set-in-dotenv
POSTGRES_USER=set-in-dotenv
POSTGRES_DB=set-in-dotenv
POSTGRES_PASSWORD=set-in-dotenv
=== compose interpolation check ===
compose-config=success
